title: Eight bars

memory.witnessed: Phil uses the paid ticket and rides the coach all the way to Pittsburgh..
You reached your sister from the terminal payphone. She confirmed the van booking for Wednesday.
memory.your_words: Hi, is the van driver still confirming for 8 AM tomorrow? I'm at the terminal now.

memory.witnessed: After that evening in Pittsburgh you woke back in your hotel bed. The radio again announced Tuesday, February 2.

shots.text: In the film, the ending is Phil playing piano. He hasn't tested this theory yet. The ballroom piano is free. This is the most direct test of his hypothesis.
